description: InheritRule.parent_rule is typed as the full RowRule union; the column-local limit is enforced only in RuleSet._check_columns, _rule_nodes skips parent_rule so walkers must descend by hand, and the allowed-kinds message reads pydantic/typing internals.
IsNullRule and IsNotNullRule differ only in their kind literal; each handler repeats the pair (duplication only).
Test assertions inspect generated SQL as text (re.findall at line 283, sql.startswith at lines 289 and 301) instead of through sqlglot.

Comment in test_a_null_test_that_changes_on_reparse_is_refused says NOT over a bare IS; the planted tree is NOT over an unparenthesized OR(IS, EQ) AND-ed with TRUE. Capped at Suggestion by the behavior-inert prose cap.
No test runs a visibility-graph cycle through a listed referenced_by link table, so an inverted or dropped 'in listed' guard in _rule_edges would go unnoticed at load time.
test_a_file_using_only_the_six_shapes_compiles_as_before compares two head-revision documents and cannot detect a change to the existing shapes' SQL.

Restart guidance claims a query reaching a renamed or dropped table is refused before it runs; check_catalog runs once at startup and the guard checks only rule-set file names, so such queries reach MySQL and fail with its own unknown-table error naming the table.
check_catalog docstring omits that parent_rule compare columns are type-checked on parent_table.

parent_rule refusal message derives allowed kinds from model_fields['kind'].annotation.__args__[0]; an annotation shape change would raise AttributeError/IndexError instead of a path-naming ValueError.
